summary: Burke County lookout: 35-ft steel tower built 1928 near Enola with an observers' cabin at its base; 1938 tower cabin by CCC camp P-57. Later history not found.

notes_for_editor: The 1928 and 1938 details come from one hobby site (Eastern US Lookouts) that quotes the state's Department of Conservation and Development biennial reports and a 3 Dec 1928 High Point Enterprise item. The originals were not opened. The paper spells the town Morgantown; the story keeps that spelling and does not assert Morganton. No source gives any history after 1938, so fate (standing, removed, or rebuilt) and public access are unknown. Do not confuse with the Horse Ridge Lookout in California (nhlr.org/lookouts/us/ca/horse-ridge-lookout), which is a different, standing tower. The brief's status and access are still unknown. Next checks: NC Division of Forest Resources records, the Burke County history museum, and Peter Barr's guide to North Carolina lookout towers.
